svg.aria-label: Type at the start of a text, in memory. Insert one character at the start of the text — every insert anchors into the same spot. Nothing touches the disk. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: TinyBase (no text that merges by position); PouchDB (no text that merges by position); RxDB (no text that merges by position); Fireproof (no text that merges by position); GUN (needs its storage adapter to answer in Node.js); OrbitDB (no text that merges by position).
